# CodeAdvantage

> > CodeAdvantage provides online and in-person coding education for kids ages 6-13 through live instructor-led classes, summer camps, and personalized tutoring across multiple programming platforms.

CodeAdvantage is a STEM education platform offering coding classes, robotics programs, and summer camps with live instruction in platforms like Scratch, Python, Minecraft, and Roblox. The organization serves students across the Northeast US with both virtual and in-person learning options, including in-school curriculum, after-school programs, and homeschool support.

## Key Topics

- Coding Education
- STEM Learning
- Scratch & Scratch Jr
- Python Programming

## Core Programs & Classes

- [CodeAdvantage | Online Coding Classes for Kids | After-School Programs](https://www.codeadvantage.org): CodeAdvantage homepage: online coding classes and after-school programs for kids ages 6-13
- [CodeAdvantage | Online Computer Coding Camps and Classes for Kids](https://www.codeadvantage.org/online-coding-classes-for-kids): Online coding classes and camps with live instruction using Scratch Jr and skill-based curriculum
- [Private Online Coding Classes For Kids| CodeAdvantage | Coding Tutoring](https://www.codeadvantage.org/private-online-classes): Private 1:1 and 2:1 online coding tutoring in Scratch, Minecraft, Roblox, and Python
- [Code Advantage](https://www.codeadvantage.org/in-school): CodeAdvantage Spark in-school STEM curriculum for K-8 computer science education
- [Home Schooling](https://www.codeadvantage.org/homeschool): CodeAdvantage homeschool coding classes with customized curriculum and personalized instruction

## Summer Camps & Seasonal Programs

- [Summer Online Coding Camps for Kids | CodeAdvantage](https://www.codeadvantage.org/online/summer-online-coding-camps-for-kids): Online summer coding camps for grades 1-10 with live teacher instruction
- [In-Person Summer Camps](https://www.codeadvantage.org/summer-camps): In-person summer STEM camps featuring coding, robotics, digital art, and eSports

## Locations & Access

- [Coding and Robotics Classes for Kids in Your Neighborhood](https://www.codeadvantage.org/all-locations): Directory of CodeAdvantage class locations across NY, MA, NJ, and PA

- [Advantage Portal](https://www.codeadvantage.org/portal-instruction): Guide to Advantage Portal features, parent tools, and class management system
